title: Senegal's President to Hold Referendum on Constitutional Reform
summary: Senegal's president, Faye, plans to hold a referendum on constitutional reform that would limit his powers. The move comes amid controversy over the country's political landscape and the role of former Prime Minister Sonko. Critics argue that the proposed reforms could undermine democratic institutions, while supporters see them as necessary for stability. The outcome of the referendum is expected to shape Senegal's future politics.
summary_points: Senegal's president plans to hold a referendum on constitutional reform
The proposed reforms would limit the president's powers
The move comes amid controversy over the country's political landscape
Critics argue that the reforms could undermine democratic institutions
Supporters see the reforms as necessary for stability
